name: Create Agent
description: Create an agent in Freshdesk. [See the documentation](https://developers.freshdesk.com/api/#create_agent)

configurable_props.name: ticketScope
configurable_props.label: Ticket Scope
configurable_props.description: Ticket permission of the agent. Current logged in agent can't update his/her ticket_scope

configurable_props.name: occasional
configurable_props.label: Occasional
configurable_props.description: Set to true if this is an occasional agent (true => occasional, false => full-time)

configurable_props.name: signature
configurable_props.label: Signature
configurable_props.description: Signature of the agent in HTML format

configurable_props.name: language
configurable_props.label: Language
configurable_props.description: Language of the Agent. Default language is `en`

configurable_props.name: timeZone
configurable_props.label: Time Zone
configurable_props.description: Time zone of the agent. Default value is time zone of the domain.

configurable_props.name: focusMode
configurable_props.label: Focus Mode
configurable_props.description: Focus mode of the agent. Default value is `true`
